string.text: Dear player, one of the toughest survival modes is now active. Expect a harsh economy, dangerous opponents, scarce resources, and a far more demanding game where mistakes become expensive quickly.
This mode is recommended for experienced players and veterans of the Zone who already know the game's mechanics well.
Prepare before you move. The Zone will not make allowances.
When enabled, the field-note warning appears on the next in-game load. After it is shown, this checkbox turns itself off.
This checkbox is a one-shot trigger: enable it, load into the game, see the warning, and it disables itself.
